issues: 新景是灰阶占位 dashboard（灰条 + 空卡片），旧景只有一个 BEFORE 大字，两景之间没有任何叙事
墨边是撕纸洞一样的锯齿黑圈，没有"墨"的浓淡层次，读作烧穿或普通 iris 擦除
没有墨滴落下的起因，圆从画面里凭空长出来
洇满后 30f 全静止，新景没有任何跟随动作
changes: look 用 paper（暖白纸 · 墨 · 朱红）：旧景是刊物《The Field Report》第 02 章扉页（150px 衬线标题 + 朱红斜体 + 正文双栏 + 书眉页码），新景是印在深靛墨底上的第 03 章——墨不是遮罩，而是新页的底色
墨的物理：墨滴从画外自由落体落下并按速度拉长 → 触纸溅出主墨团 + 7 粒卫星墨点 → 线性与 ease-out 各半的洇开 + 低频扰动，卫星被主墨团吞并
墨的层次：湿晕（极淡暖暗）/ 高频须状淡墨跑在最前 / 比墨底更浓的墨边 / 新景显影，四层同 seed 位移遮罩
跟随与收尾：106f 摘罩真静止，朱红细线描出、副题逐词由虚到实，相机极缓推近 1.5%；尾帧是完整的章节海报
落墨点放在右侧，让新章大标题最后被墨染到；时长 152f
issuesEn: The new scene was a greyscale placeholder dashboard (grey bars, empty cards) and the old scene was a single word, BEFORE, with no story between them
The ink edge was a jagged black ring like a hole torn in paper, with no light and dark in the ink, so it read as a burn-through or a plain iris wipe
Nothing caused it: no drop fell, the circle just grew out of the frame
After filling the frame it held completely still for 30f with no follow-through on the new scene
changesEn: Paper look (warm paper, ink, vermilion): the old scene is the Chapter 02 opener of a magazine, The Field Report (150px serif headline, vermilion italic, two body columns, running head and folio); the new scene is Chapter 03 printed on deep indigo ink, so the ink is the new page's ground rather than a mask

Ink physics: a drop free-falls in from off frame, stretching with speed, then hits the paper with a main splat and 7 satellite droplets, and spreads on a half-linear, half-ease-out curve with low-frequency wobble while the satellites are swallowed
Layered ink: a faint warm wet halo, a high-frequency diluted fringe running ahead, an edge denser than the ink ground, then the new scene developing, all four sharing one seeded displacement

Follow-through and ending: the mask comes off at 106f for a truly still frame, a vermilion rule draws in, the subline resolves word by word from blur and the camera pushes in 1.5%; the last frame is a finished chapter poster
The drop lands on the right so the new chapter headline is inked last; 152f total
